notes:
Account background:
- Product: in-app contextual assistant + knowledge search embedded in their B2B product. Mid-market customers, heavy docs+SLA sensitive.
- Trial: started hosted API trial 2026-01-20 (free credits). Embedded quickstart integrated in Staging by 2026-02-05.

Recent timeline (shorthand):
- 2026-02-03: Intro demo (Priya/Liam) — high-level hosted API flow, cost buckets. Customer: PM + infra lead + security.
- 2026-02-10: Quick PoC kickoff — sample integration using chat+embeddings. Logged Fireflies ff_2026-02-20_skybridge-demo.
- 2026-02-18: Security review submission (SAML + SOC2 docs requested).
- 2026-02-25: Hosted trial metrics review — sent initial dashboard.
- 2026-03-02: Security deep-dive with SRE (ff_2026-03-02_security-review).
- 2026-03-08: Pricing call to discuss reserved capacity and expected committed throughput.

POC / traffic observed during hosted trial (production-sim sandbox):
- Duration: 2 weeks simulation traffic (synthetic + beta customers).
- Avg QPS observed (bulk): 6 QPS sustained during business hours (M-F 9-18 PT).
- Peak observed bursts up to ~28 QPS for 3-5 minute windows (concurrent interactive sessions).
- Typical request shape: 60% chat (multi-turn), 30% embeddings (semantic search), 10% reranking/summarization.
- Token mix (avg): prompt/context ~300 tokens, generations ~240 tokens per response. Embedding calls ~512 tokens avg.
- Avg tokens per request (weighted): ~360 tokens.
- Concurrency: average 12 concurrent active chat streams; peak concurrency measured 42 across beta cohort.
- Daily requests during trial: ~25k requests/day (mix of chat/embedding).

Customer requirements / priorities:
- Latency: median response target <350ms for short-response flows, tail p99 <1s for interactive features.
- Throughput: need predictable capacity for product launch (initial target: 2k DAUs, convert to 120k requests/day).
- Cost: budget-conscious. Unit-cost sensitivity high — wants clear breakpoints for batching/quantization savings.
- Compliance: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logs, and optional EU data residency for customers.
- Fallbacks: prefer automated routing to cheaper variant under load (hosted->dedicated fallback policy).

Dedicated sizing ask (customer request):
- Provide recommended dedicated capacity profile to handle forecasted launch traffic with 2x headroom.
- Forecast targets provided by customer: 120k requests/day, expected 18 QPS sustained with peaks to 60 QPS, peak concurrency ~80 active streams.
- Token forecast: average 360 tokens/request -> ~43.2M tokens/day. Peak-day buffer x1.8.
- Recommended initial commit: configuration options requested: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs or Redwood Dedicated instance profile X (submit cost/latency tradeoffs).
- Interested in auto-scaling/burst overage pricing vs larger reserved commit.

Questions they flagged for Redwood team:
- Exact QPS-to-GPU mapping given their token mix and multi-turn KV cache: "how many concurrent users per GPU at our token profile?"
- Expected p99 latency for multi-turn chats vs single-turn summarization at proposed sizing.
- Pricing scenarios: reserved monthly vs burst usage (savings thresholds).
- Data residency: confirm VPC private control plane option and KMS integration for EU pockets.

Action items for Redwood (short):
- Deliver capacity-sizing spreadsheet with assumptions (QPS => GPU mapping, concurrency per device, token throughput), attached to Drive PO: /drive/Skybridge/POC-traffic-forecast.xlsx.
- Produce 3 pricing scenarios: small commit (2 GPUs), recommended (4 GPUs), aggressive (8 GPUs) with monthly ARR and per-token unit economics.
- Provide SLA language snippet for data residency & audit logging to legal for review.
- SE deep-dive to validate p99 latency numbers on matching model variants and quantization profiles (Liam owner).

Sales notes (tone):
- PM commented: "Need predictable unit economics — we can't have token surprises at scale."
- Infra lead: "If we can get a clear sizing + burst policy, we'll push PO through procurement by June."
- Risk: competitor (openai) pricing is lower for on-demand but lacks dedicated routing/enterprise SLAs they want.

Next meeting: 2026-03-16 (deep-dive sizing + draft PO).
